product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - IEC 60320 C20 to IEC 60320 C13 14AWG 15A/1875W 3-Prong SJT Black 3ft
product.description: Extend the reach of your AC powered device using this AC power extension cord to energize equipment from a distant power outlet. This cable features a standard, grounded IEC 60320 C20 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 receptacle on the other. IEC 60320 C20 to C13 power cords are commonly used between high‑output rack mounted equipment and the PDU in a data cabinet.
